text:
Leah Kim: Quick sync — we need a final checklist for the SecretsHub partner launch (KMS/HSM + SCIM + SSO). Target announce: next Wed. Who owns what?

Raj Patel: I can own KMS/HSM compatibility sign-off. Need s/w integration test vectors from partner by EOD Friday.

Sofia Alvarez: I'll handle marketplace listing copy + compliance blurb. cc @marketing. Need pricing tier and logo assets.

Omar El-Hassan: On scim/identity side — we need attribute mapping table and a sample SCIM patch flow. Can partner confirm support for custom schemas?

Raj Patel: Partner said HSM via PKCS#11 and cloud KMS. We need to validate key wrapping and rotate flow. Devon, can you put together required test cases?

Devon (eng-security): Yup. I'll write a quick test matrix. Off the top: create/decrypt/sign with wrapped keys, rotate key, import from HSM. Will post commands.

Maya (marketplace-bot): Reminder: marketplace submission window closes 48h before publish. Upload package and screenshots by Monday 16:00 UTC.

Leah Kim: Timeline: Fri — engineering sign-off (KMS/HSM). Mon — marketplace package + press draft. Tue — legal/PR sweep. Wed — joint blog + partner press release. Everyone ok?

Sofia Alvarez: OK. I'll draft blog outline now. Need a 2-paragraph product summary and 1 customer quote (we can use generic if partner not ready).

Omar El-Hassan: SCIM details — proposed mapping snippet below (partner to Redwood):
```
partner: externalId -> redwood:user_id
partner: displayName -> redwood:name
partner: mail -> redwood:email
partner: groups -> redwood:team_ids (array)
```
Partner must support bulk PATCH with 10k users/hour.

Raj Patel: For KMS tests, Devon — add these quick commands (examples):
```bash
# wrap/unwarp flow (pseudo)
openssl genrsa -out key.pem 2048
redwood kms import --key key.pem --provider hsm --label partner-test
redwood kms encrypt --key-label partner-test --in payload.bin --out payload.enc
redwood kms decrypt --key-label partner-test --in payload.enc --out payload.bin
```

Devon (eng-security): Added. Also adding a test for latency under rotate: rotate -> read 1000 tokens concurrently.

Sofia Alvarez: Marketing checklist: launch banner, partner logo (SVG), 1 hero screenshot, marketplace short + long description, contact CTA. I'll ping design.

Leah Kim: Legal — partner NDA + mutual PR embargo required. Sofia, can you confirm legal has partner NDA signed by Monday?

Sofia Alvarez: On it. Already nudged legal.

Omar El-Hassan: Partner asked about SAML metadata exchange window. We should schedule a metadata handoff call Tue morning. Who's available?

Raj Patel: I can do Tue 10am PT. Devon can join for security sign-off.

Leah Kim: Great — I'll send calendar invite. Action items summary: 
- Raj: KMS/HSM sign-off + test vectors (due Fri EOD).
- Devon: security test matrix + rotate/latency tests (due Fri EOD).
- Omar: SCIM attribute mapping + confirm bulk patch window with partner (due Fri).
- Sofia: marketplace package + press draft + legal check (due Mon 16:00 UTC).
- Leah: send metadata handoff invite and own announcement timeline.

Maya (marketplace-bot): Note: marketplace preview URL will be available after upload — include it in the PR checklist. :white_check_mark:

Raj Patel: One more — fallback policy if HSM course fails: route to cloud KMS variant and add note in docs. We'll draft the fallback YAML for runtime routing.

Leah Kim: Perfect. If nobody objects, we'll treat this as the canonical plan and reconvene Tue after the metadata call. Thanks all :rocket:
